title: GitHub - theJian/squint-mcp: Most LLMs see images. With squint-mcp, the rest imagine seeing them.
excerpt: Most LLMs see images. With squint-mcp, the rest imagine seeing them. - theJian/squint-mcp
content_html:
Most LLMs see images. With squint-mcp, the rest imagine seeing them.

squint-mcp turns images into ASCII art for text-only LLMs (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.2). They can then squint, crop, squint harder, and eventually announce that your toaster is probably a building.

To use it:

{
  "mcp": {
    "squint": {
      "type": "local",
      "command": ["npx", "-y", "squint-mcp"]
    }
  }
}

Q & A

Is this vision?

Not really. It is ASCII art doing a vision impression.

Can it read tiny text?

It can try. Sometimes the text comes back as decorative soup.

Why not use a vision model?

That would solve the problem.

How is it different from a vision model?

It burns more tokens and takes forever—all for worse results.

Is it any good?

No. But every now and then it gets something right, which is much worse for everyone.

Contributing

If you make it less wonky, more useful, or better at distinguishing dogs from furniture, pull requests are welcome.

License

Not decided yet. The code is young. Please be kind to it.

content_html_zh:
大多数法学硕士都会看到图像。 有了squint-mcp，其他人就可以想象看到它们。

sqint-mcp 将图像转换为纯文本 LLM 的 ASCII 艺术（DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GLM-5.2）。 然后他们可以眯着眼睛、裁剪、更用力地眯着眼睛，最终宣布你的烤面包机可能是一座建筑物。

使用方法：

{
  "mcp": {
    "squint": {
      "type": "local",
      "command": ["npx", "-y", "squint-mcp"]
    }
  }
}

Q & A

这是愿景吗？

并不真地。 这是一种视觉印象的 ASCII 艺术。

它可以读取微小的文字吗？

可以尝试一下。 有时，文本会作为装饰汤返回。

为什么不使用视觉模型？

这样就解决了问题。

它与视觉模型有何不同？

它会燃烧更多的代币并花费很长时间——这一切都是为了更糟糕的结果。

有什么好处吗？

不。但有时它会得到一些正确的结果，这对每个人来说都更糟糕。

贡献

如果你让它不那么古怪，更有用，或者更好地区分狗和家具，欢迎拉请求。

执照

还没决定。 代码很年轻。 请善待它。
